opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: up to £200 (Scheme A), up to £500 (Scheme B), up to £750 (Adelphi co‑sponsored Scheme B), up to £300 (Scheme C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scheme A: undergraduate, MSc and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva. Schemes B & C: PhD students and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva. Applicants must be UK‑based members (or non‑UK members attending UK conferences) and must present a poster or talk.
opportunities.summary: Grants to support attendance of Genetics Society junior scientists at conferences (Society meetings, non‑Society meetings, or virtual conferences).

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or attending a UK‑based course. Students must be members; other applicants need at least one year of membership.
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £1,200 to support attendance at short genetics‑related training courses or collaborative visits to other laboratories.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students need a supervisor’s letter; others need at least one year of membership.
opportunities.summary: Awards to cover travel and accommodation for field‑based genetic research projects, with the aim of producing results suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Grants to support public engagement activities related to genetics, covering travel and material costs (UK‑based travel only).
